findings.statement: ITK is a Tec family kinase that regulates T-cell receptor signaling and T cell responses.

citation.title: Regulation of T-cell responses and disease by tec kinase Itk.

findings.statement: ITK deficiency impairs interferon-gamma immunity and causes increased susceptibility to tuberculosis.

citation.title: Inherited human ITK deficiency impairs IFN-γ immunity and underlies tuberculosis.

findings.statement: ITK inhibition treats autoimmune arthritis by altering T cell differentiation and function.

citation.title: Targeting kinase ITK treats autoimmune arthritis via orchestrating T cell differentiation and function.

findings.statement: Inhibition of ITK enhances chimeric antigen receptor T cell persistence and anti-tumor efficacy.

citation.title: IL-2-inducible T cell kinase deficiency sustains chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy against tumor cells.

findings.statement: BCL10 is a component of the CBM complex that forms part of the molecular machinery linking immune receptor signaling to NF-κB activation downstream of CARD11.

citation.title: Immunodeficiency and CARD-BCL10-MALT1.

findings.statement: BCL10 functions in regulatory T cell development and homeostasis as part of the CARD11-containing signaling pathway.

citation.title: CARD11 signaling in regulatory T cell development and function.

findings.statement: BCL10 regulates neutrophil NETosis (neutrophil extracellular trap formation) and its inhibition can reduce sepsis-induced multiorgan damage.

citation.title: Emodin Alleviates Sepsis-Induced Multiorgan Damage by Inhibiting NETosis through Targeting Neutrophils BCL-10.

findings.statement: TSC1 and TSC2 form a complex that negatively regulates mTOR signaling, a pathway implicated in cell growth and aging.

citation.title: Rapamycin for longevity: the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.

findings.statement: Pathogenic variants in TSC1 cause tuberous sclerosis complex, an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by benign tumor growth in multiple organ systems.

citation.title: Tuberous sclerosis complex.

findings.statement: TSC1 mutations lead to lymphangioleiomyomatosis, a progressive cystic lung disease affecting primarily women of reproductive age.

citation.title: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis: a metastatic lung disease.

findings.statement: Loss of TSC1 in macrophages impairs the AKT/MST1/NRF2 signaling axis, amplifying sterile inflammatory liver injury.

citation.title: Loss of macrophage TSC1 exacerbates sterile inflammatory liver injury through inhibiting the AKT/MST1/NRF2 signaling pathway.

findings.statement: LCP2 is a lymphocyte cytosolic protein required for normal T cell signaling and function.

citation.title: Modulating T-cell activation with antisense oligonucleotides targeting lymphocyte cytosolic protein 2.

findings.statement: Biallelic LCP2 variants cause combined immunodeficiency with impaired PI3K signaling.

citation.title: Combined immunodeficiency and impaired PI3K signaling in a patient with biallelic LCP2 variants.

findings.statement: LCP2 inhibition in T cells reduces apoptosis and oxidative stress through modulation of the PD-1/PD-L1 pathway.

citation.title: Inhibition of LCP2 in T cells alleviated apoptosis and oxidative stress via PD-1/PD-L1 in diabetic retinopathy.

findings.statement: LCP2 expression correlates with infiltration of CD8+ T cells in metastatic melanoma and serves as a prognostic biomarker.

citation.title: A novel prognostic biomarker LCP2 correlates with metastatic melanoma-infiltrating CD8(+) T cells.

findings.statement: VPS37 protein depletion destabilizes ESCRT-I complexes and triggers cellular stress responses.

citation.title: Concurrent depletion of Vps37 proteins evokes ESCRT-I destabilization and profound cellular stress responses.

findings.statement: ZNF250 is transcriptionally activated by cancer-associated fibroblast-derived exosomes and promotes hepatocellular carcinoma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion through PD-L1 activation.

citation.title: Cancer-associated fibroblasts-derived exosomal ZNF250 promotes the proliferation, migration, invasion, and immune escape of hepatocellular carcinoma cells by transcriptionally activating PD-L1.

findings.statement: ZNF250 is regulated by the miR-1245a/lncRNA AC116914.2 axis and promotes oral cancer progression.

citation.title: LncRNA AC116914.2 promotes the progression of oral cancer by targeting METTL3 via miR-1245a/ZNF250.

findings.statement: ZNF250 is a key transcription factor identified in the genomic landscapes of human sarcomas.

citation.title: A systems biological approach to identify key transcription factors and their genomic neighborhoods in human sarcomas.

findings.statement: VAV1 is a guanine nucleotide exchange factor that regulates T cell receptor signaling and T cell function.

citation.title: Base-editing mutagenesis maps alleles to tune human T cell functions.

findings.statement: VAV1 is implicated in the pathogenesis of autoimmune and chronic inflammatory diseases, making it a candidate for therapeutic intervention.

citation.title: VAV1 as a putative therapeutic target in autoimmune and chronic inflammatory diseases.

findings.statement: VAV1 activates ERK signaling downstream of HSPA8 ubiquitination to suppress triple-negative breast cancer proliferation.

citation.title: Pristimerin Promotes Ubiquitination of HSPA8 and Activates the VAV1/ERK Pathway to Suppress TNBC Proliferation.

findings.statement: VAV1 expression is elevated in angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, identifying it as a potential therapeutic vulnerability.

citation.title: Integrative Genomic and Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals Targetable Vulnerabilities in Angioimmunoblastic T-Cell Lymphoma.

findings.statement: IL-2Rα is a therapeutic target for enhancing T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity when engaged by receptor-masked IL-2 immunocytokines.

citation.title: A PD-1-targeted, receptor-masked IL-2 immunocytokine that engages IL-2Rα strengthens T cell-mediated anti-tumor therapies.

findings.statement: IL2RA function is central to regulatory T cell (Treg) development and maintenance, with genetic variations in IL2RA associated with autoimmune diseases.

citation.title: Transcriptional and epigenetic basis of Treg cell development and function: its genetic anomalies or variations in autoimmune diseases.

findings.statement: IL-2 signaling through IL-2Rα can be harnessed to reprogram human T cell function and specificity for therapeutic purposes.

citation.title: Reprogramming human T cell function and specificity with non-viral genome targeting.

findings.statement: NFKB2 mediates immune escape in colorectal cancer by promoting PD-L1 expression through a STAT2-dependent mechanism.

citation.title: NFKB2 mediates colorectal cancer cell immune escape and metastasis in a STAT2/PD‐L1‐dependent manner.

findings.statement: NFKB2 mutations cause primary immunodeficiency characterized by impaired type I interferon responses and autoantibody production against interferons.

citation.title: Autoantibodies against type I IFNs in humans with alternative NF-κB pathway deficiency.

findings.statement: NFKB2 functions in the noncanonical NF-κB pathway, which regulates SPP1 expression in melanoma progression.

citation.title: BET inhibitor suppresses melanoma progression via the noncanonical NF-κB/SPP1 pathway.

findings.statement: Genetic mutations in NFKB2 are associated with altered immunological and clinical features in primary immunodeficiency patients.

citation.title: Clinical, Immunological, and Genetic Features in Patients with NFKB1 and NFKB2 Mutations: a Systematic Review.
